[PREFERENCE] User thinks taking a break would help them clear their head and focus on their priorities.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Assistant supports the idea of taking social media breaks and provides benefits, including reduced information overload, increased focus, improved mental health, and enhanced creativity.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Assistant offers tips for making the most of social media breaks, including setting clear goals, scheduling the break, using website blockers, finding alternative activities, reflecting and journaling, setting boundaries, and planning for re-entry.
